description: What scripts/run-tests.mjs does not run from test/*.mjs (RR-46). A new Node test needs no entry; add a file here only when it is a helper, fixture or harness, or a check that CI runs in its own step. Files named *-browser*.mjs are browser suites (test/browser-suites.json, scripts/quarantine.mjs) and are skipped by name. RR-53: contractExclude lists the tests the contract suite (npm run test:contract, run by core's pull-request tier) leaves out, each with its reason; every other test of the full run is in the contract.
